title: 第15章 吃哑巴亏赔钱第16章 鸡不过六狗不过八

李向东看向声音的源头。
不出意料，来的正是绕一个圈，脚底下泥巴都还没干，却装作路过的村长李宏财。
“呦，叔，这么晚什么风把你给吹来了！”
李宏财看向对面心知肚明，却还明知故问，气不打一处来。
皮笑肉不笑道：
“村子里闹出这么大的动静，我能不来看看？”
说罢大摇大摆走到胖鱼贩身边，厉声道：
“你是谁？怎么从没见过你？是你在收李二狗的鱼吗？
胖鱼贩被他这么当面一吓，额头冷汗直流。
“不......不是我......”
“嗯？”李宏财眼睛一瞪：“这里就你一个外人，不是你还能是谁！”
“再不老实，我这就打电话叫镇里派出所的老何把你抓起来。”
李宏财这段话看似威胁，实则透露出很多信息。
胖鱼贩如果不撇清和他李宏财的关系，恐怕以后要吃不了兜着走。
想清楚了这一点，胖鱼贩苦着脸认栽：“是我在收他的鱼。”
眼见有人认了，李宏财脸上的威严淡去一些，转身朝着李向东笑道。
“向东，今晚这事，你看怎么处理？”
李向东手里把玩着手机，嘴角上扬：“我啊，死读书一个的书呆子，没什么经验。”
“要不，您帮我参谋参谋这事怎么解决？”

李宏财抛出去的皮球又原模原样提了回来，内心气到要爆炸。
心中暗道：
就你这布局的能力，这挖坑给人跳的智商，你说你没什么经验。
鬼才信你！
“你要是信得过叔，那这事就交给叔来处理。”
“你可不能不知道，最近咱们桃花村正在评选乡里的十大文明村。”
“若是今晚这个事传出去，面上多少有些难看，会让人笑话呢。”
李向东听出他的意思是要私了，所谓的评选文明村无非是个幌子。
一个台阶而已。
“这样啊，那您看着办吧，只要是对咱们村有利的事情，我作为村民肯定得支持啊。”
“只是我这池塘里三千多斤鱼吧，都不见了，明天一早没法和我父亲交代。”
李二狗搞出这么大的阵仗，费劲力气才捞上来三百多斤的鱼。
听到李向东狮子大开口要赔三千斤，气得浑身发抖，仗着身边人多喝骂道：

Li Xiangdong looked at the source of the sound.
As expected, the person who came was the village chief Li Hongcai, who was making a circle and pretending to be passing by even though the mud was still wet under his feet.
"Hey, uncle, what brought you here so late at night!"
Li Hongcai looked at the other side and knew it, but he still asked questions knowingly, and he was very angry.
Pi Xiaorou Bu smiled and said:
"There is such a big commotion in the village, can I not come and take a look?"
After that, he swaggered up to the fat fishmonger and said sternly:
"Who are you? How come I've never seen you before? Are you collecting Li Ergou's fish?
The fat fishmonger was so frightened by him that he broke out in cold sweat on his forehead.
"No...it's not me..."
"Huh? Li Hongcai's eyes widened: "You are the only outsider here, who else could it be if not you?" "
"If you are still dishonest, I will call Lao He from the town police station to arrest you. "
Li Hongcai's words may seem threatening, but in fact they reveal a lot of information.
If the fat fishmonger doesn't clear up his relationship with Li Hongcai, he may not be able to afford it in the future.
After thinking about this clearly, the fat fishmonger admitted his defeat with a grimace: "I am collecting his fish. "
Seeing that someone recognized him, the majesty on Li Hongcai's face faded a little, and he turned around and smiled at Li Xiangdong.
"Xiangdong, how do you want to handle this matter tonight? "
Li Xiangdong played with his mobile phone in his hand and raised the corners of his mouth: "I am a nerd who just studies and I have no experience. "
"How about you help me advise me on how to solve this matter? "
The ball thrown by Li Hongcai was brought back exactly as it was, and he was so angry that he wanted to explode.
I thought to myself:
As far as your layout ability and your IQ in digging holes to make people jump, you said you have little experience.
Only ghosts believe you!
"If you can trust me, then let me handle this matter. "
"You must know that our Taohua Village is currently selecting the top ten civilized villages in the township. "
"If this matter were to spread out tonight, it would be somewhat ugly and would make people laugh. "
Li Xiangdong heard that he meant to keep things secret. The so-called selection of civilized villages was nothing more than a cover.
Just one step.
"That's it, then you can do whatever you want. As long as it is beneficial to our village, I, as a villager, must support it. "
"It's just that the more than 3,000 kilograms of fish in my pond are all gone. I won't be able to tell my father tomorrow morning. "
Li Ergou created such a big battle and struggled to catch more than 300 kilograms of fish.
Hearing Li Xiangdong's loud request for compensation of three thousand kilograms, he was so angry that he trembled all over. Taking advantage of the crowd around him, he yelled and cursed:
